description: For every maximal antichain A in a tree of height omega_1 with countable levels, there are chosen comparable witnesses a(t) in A whose reflection bounds are countable. At every nonzero limit cut delta closed under these bounds, the witnesses of nodes below delta stay below delta, and A restricted to those nodes is a maximal antichain. The nonzero limit cuts on which witnesses stay below the cut form a club.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.antichain_reflection (T : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.Tree)
  (hheight : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.treeHeight T = (Cardinal.aleph 1).ord)
  (hc : ∀ (α : Ordinal.{0}), (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.level T α).Countable) (A : Set T.carrier)
  (hA : IsMaxAntichain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) A) :
  ∃ a,
    (∀ (t : T.carrier), a t ∈ A ∧ (a t ≤ t ∨ t ≤ a t)) ∧
      (∀ (β : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.OmegaOne),
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.ReflectionBound T a β < (Cardinal.aleph 1).ord) ∧
        (∀ (δ : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.OmegaOne),
            Order.IsSuccLimit δ →
              (∀ β < δ, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.ReflectionBound T a β < ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd δ)) →
                (∀ (t : T.carrier),
                    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.nodeHeight T t < ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd δ) →
                      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.nodeHeight T (a t) < ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd δ)) ∧
                  IsMaxAntichain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) {t | ↑t ∈ A}) ∧
          IsClub
            {δ |
              Order.IsSuccLimit δ ∧
                ∀ (t : T.carrier),
                  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.nodeHeight T t < ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd δ) →
                    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.nodeHeight T (a t) < ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd δ)}
